diagnosis.conclusion: The regression is reproduced by flex alone, while nearest_cells alone is slightly faster. An 8.268m certified shift of station8 changes the following route heuristic branch to outer-ring station19; the shifted start alone is sufficient in a one-step routing counterfactual. Late discovery of channel3 delays the 16-source stopping condition and doubles station visits.
diagnosis.limitations: This is one synthetic worst-case diagnosis, not another benchmark or parameter search. Routing counterfactuals evaluate only the immediate next ordering and do not claim full alternate task outcomes. Continuous coverage guarantees detection eventually but does not bound task-time regret.

trace_note: detect.trace.theta originates in the underlying LocalSimulator before bootstrap rounds. The policy actually receives radians(round(degrees(theta), 2) % 360). Position, time and status are exact trace values.
